 Charlotte Coates
 Most recent Most popular 'Rice really looks up for it' published at 16:58 GMT 16:58 GMT 
 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 Danny Murphy 
Match of the Day pundit 
 Declan Rice always plays well, but he really looks up for it today. Brilliant for the goal, great tackle on Barcola. He's just so instrumental to this Arsenal side. His athleticism, his quality just always stand out. It's been a brilliant start to the game from him.

 Barcola bringing the fireworks.
 Matt, Bristol

 Post published at 16:58 GMT 16:58 GMT 
 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 Stephen Warnock 
Former Liverpool defender on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 What a game this is. End-to-end. 
 Liverpool are really growing into this game and knocking on the door.
 23 18 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 28 mins 28 mins 
 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 The out-swinging corner bounces off the head of Virgil van Dijk and Alexander Isak tries to sneak it in but David Raya does enough. Just. 
 188 80 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 27 mins 27 mins 
 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 Turns out Alisson didn't save Kai Havertz' effort, it hit Jurrien Timber!
 113 109 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 27 mins 27 mins 
 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 Liverpool are coming on strong here but Arsenal are defending with everything they have as the home side have another corner. 
 225 68 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 26 mins 26 mins 
 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 Now Liverpool have a free-kick after Alisson pings it up the pitch for Cody Gakpo, but he's brought down by Riccardo Calafiori. 
 190 110 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 26 mins 26 mins 
 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 How's that stayed out then?
 Christos Tzolis stands out up for Kai Havertz at the back post and Alisson has somehow kept it out. 
 280 115 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Much better from Liverpool published at 16:55 GMT 16:55 GMT 
 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 Aadam Patel 
Football Reporter at Anfield 
 Much better from Liverpool since going behind. Bradley Barcola is asking plenty of questions of the Arsenal backline and already you get the sense that the next goal will be so important. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 390 221 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 25 mins 25 mins 
 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 Inches away from a second for Arsenal as Milos Kerkez stands off Noni Madueke. 
 He then pops it back for Bruno Guimaraes to strike but it's always curling away from the far post. 
 215 169 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:54 GMT 16:54 GMT 
 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 Stephen Warnock 
Former Liverpool defender on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Barcola has come to life. Suddenly he's started to get on the ball and that is exactly what he has to do. Gakpo is trying to have more of an influence as well.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 362 161 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 16:54 GMT 16:54 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' at the top of this page to have your say 
 Gabriel should have been booked if only for the influence on young players watching!
 Graham, Kend 
 Arsenal being Arsenal already. Gabriel should have been booked for simulation.
 Gary, Essex 
 Gabriel is an embarrassment. If VAR review an incident and think a player is trying to con (cheat) the referee they should allow the referee to review the incident and allow them to issue a yellow card. It's effectively simulation (cheating) and needs eradicating from the game.
 Gareth, Barnsley 
 729 347 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 23 mins 23 mins 
 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 Credit to Liverpool here. 
 The goal has woken them up. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 380 186 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 23 mins 23 mins 
 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 This is a real test for Arsenal now as Bradley Barcola cuts another back into the box but it's half-cleared. 
 Cody Gakpo then gives Jurrien Timber a little shove and the referee gives the foul.

 The corner is dreadful.

 Alex Howell 
BBC Sport Arsenal reporter 
 A near enough perfect start to this game from Arsenal. 
 Incredible energy from Rice as usual to overlap for the goal and he's really imposing himself on this game.

 Bradley Barcola has come alive and he wins another corner.

 Liverpool work it short and Bradley Barcola whips in a delicious ball but Alexander Isak can't reach it. 
 Jurrien Timber had a fistful of his shirt but nothing from it.
